title: Asterix and the Great Rescue - Gaulish Village
description:
Here's a BG that did prove to be close to hard. BG was released at Summer C3 2023. I did manage to arrange the palettes well. Keep in mind it uses many GFX files.
You can use patches like the No Status Bar patch or the SMB3 Status Bar patch.
Credit not needed.
